Attached: 1 image

That spare Raspberry Pi could be running your own online office suite.

In our step-by-step tutorial, we show you how to get Collabora Online up and running using the official CODE Docker image. No reverse proxy or SQL database needed, making it a straightforward way to try it on your own hardware.

Not using a Pi? The same process works on most x86-64, ARM64 and PPC64 Linux hosts. 

🎥 Watch the tutorial: https://buff.ly/rH7PSMH 

#CollaboraOnline #RaspberryPi #SelfHosted #Docker #FOSS
